sentences.text: Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged" scheme aims to distribute daisy players to visually challenged students pursuing 9th Class to Degree as per the Action Plan 2017-18.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Aids/Appliances
**Where it applies:** Andhra Pradesh; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** The Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled & Senior Citizens launched the "Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged" scheme to distribute free daisy players to visually challenged students pursuing 9th Class to Degree as per the Action Plan 2017-18. The Assistant Directors and District Managers are instructed to follow these guidelines to ensure proper distribution. The application is accepted online for this scheme.
**Benefits / Assistance:** Eligible beneficiaries of this scheme will be provided with a DAISY Player to facilitate accessible learning and information access.

**Application Process:** **Step 01:** Visit the official website: [https://apdascac.ap.gov.in](https://apdascac.ap.gov.in) **Step 02:** On the homepage, click on "[APDASCAC Schemes](https://apdascac.ap.gov.in/APDASCAC-Schemes/)". **Step 03:** Select the "Sanction of DAISY Players" option. **Step 04:** Click on "[Apply Now](https://apdascac.ap.gov.in/Schemes/daisy-players/)" to begin the application process. **Step 05:** Fill in the required details and submit your application.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Dept of Social Welfare, WCD
**Tags:** Daisy Players, Person With Disabilities, Student
